clues: a one-page letter comes out as many pages of strange symbols
only jobs sent from one PC print badly
a configuration page printed from the printer panel looks fine while jobs from one PC are garbled
the PC that sends garbled jobs was set up with a driver for a different model

answer.cause: a wrong or corrupt printer driver
answer.action: Install the correct driver for the printer model and operating system

firstStep: Print a configuration page from the printer's own panel
appliesWhen: garbled output comes from one PC while the printer's own test page is clean
explanation: The driver turns the job into the printer's language, such as PCL or PostScript. A wrong or corrupt driver sends data the printer cannot read, so it prints garbage; install the right driver and language setting.
source: CompTIA A+ Core 1 and Core 2 Exam Cram, 2nd ed. – Chapter 28: Troubleshooting Printers; CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: pages show wavy lines and random patterns of dots
jobs from every PC come out scrambled the same way
the configuration page printed from the panel is also scrambled
a new driver did not fix the scrambled pages

answer.cause: a failed formatter board
answer.action: Replace the formatter board

appliesWhen: every job and the printer's own test page come out scrambled
explanation: The formatter board turns the data the printer receives into commands for its parts. When even the printer's own page is scrambled, the fault is inside the printer, and the formatter board must be replaced.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: paper jams just as each page reaches the output tray
pages show creases at the trailing edge
the receptionist has to pull each page out while it is still printing to avoid a jam
the rear door shows the stuck sheet at the very end of the path

answer.cause: worn exit rollers
answer.action: Replace all the exit rollers

appliesWhen: pages jam right at the end of the paper path
explanation: Exit rollers guide the paper out to the tray, and pulling pages out wears them. A jam just before the output tray points to them; replace them all at once because one worn roller is enough to jam.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: pages jam right after they pass the transfer area
the stuck sheets cling to the toner cartridge
a thin part just past the transfer roller is bent and loose
the jams happen even though the paper is dry and of the right weight

answer.cause: a damaged static-charge eliminator strip
answer.action: Replace the static-charge eliminator strip

appliesWhen: pages stick to the cartridge and jam just after the transfer step
explanation: The static-charge eliminator strip drains the transfer charge from the paper. If it is damaged, the charge stays on the page and the page sticks to the cartridge and jams.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: the print gets lighter on every page
the whole page is evenly pale
the printer panel shows a supply warning
shaking the cartridge makes the next few pages darker

answer.cause: a toner cartridge that is almost empty
answer.action: Replace the toner cartridge with a manufacturer-approved one

appliesWhen: the whole page is evenly light and gets lighter as more pages print
explanation: Faded prints on a laser printer most often mean low toner. Shaking the cartridge spreads the toner that is left for a short time, but the cartridge must be replaced.
source: CompTIA A+ Core 1 and Core 2 Exam Cram, 2nd ed. – Chapter 28: Troubleshooting Printers; CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: characters on the receipts look pale and gray
the print has slowly faded over the last few weeks
the faded characters are complete with no missing dots
the fading printer has printed thousands of forms since it was last serviced

answer.cause: a worn-out ink ribbon
answer.action: Replace the ribbon

appliesWhen: an impact printer's characters fade evenly over time
explanation: An impact printer strikes the ribbon to put ink on the page, and the ribbon runs dry with use. Faded but complete characters mean the ribbon must be replaced.
source: CompTIA A+ Core 1 and Core 2 Exam Cram, 2nd ed. – Chapter 28: Troubleshooting Printers; CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: the printer reports no paper picked up although the tray is full
sometimes the paper moves only partway in
the rubber rollers in the printer that will not feed look shiny and smooth
the printer that fails to pick up paper has printed over 200,000 pages

answer.cause: worn pickup rollers
answer.action: Replace the pickup rollers or install the maintenance kit

appliesWhen: the printer fails to pull paper from a full tray because the rollers are smooth
explanation: Pickup rollers use friction to pull each sheet in, and they wear smooth with use. Replace them, or install the maintenance kit that includes rollers, pads, and the fuser.
source: CompTIA A+ Core 1 and Core 2 Exam Cram, 2nd ed. – Chapter 28: Troubleshooting Printers; CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: two or three sheets go through together on many jobs
the multiple feeds happen even with fresh paper from a dry, sealed pack
the small cork patch under the pickup roller is glazed and slick
the printer that feeds several sheets at once sits in a dry, air-conditioned room

answer.cause: a worn separation pad
answer.action: Replace the separation pad

appliesWhen: the printer pulls several sheets at once even with good dry paper
explanation: The separation pad holds back the sheets below the top one so the roller picks one at a time. A worn pad lets several sheets through together.
source: CompTIA A+ Core 1 and Core 2 Exam Cram, 2nd ed. – Chapter 28: Troubleshooting Printers; CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: the printer pulls several sheets at once almost every time
the multiple feeds get worse in summer when the room is very humid
the sheets that stick together come from opened reams on an open shelf next to the printer
a fresh ream from a sealed pack feeds one sheet at a time

answer.cause: damp paper that sticks together
answer.action: Keep the paper wrapped until use and lower the humidity in the room

appliesWhen: the paper has absorbed moisture from humid air
explanation: Paper that is not dry sticks together and feeds in groups. Keep it wrapped until it is needed and keep the humidity around 50 percent or lower.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: the five-part shipping forms bunch up and jam
single sheets print without trouble while the multipart forms jam
the forms tear at the tractor holes
on the printer that jams forms, the thickness lever beside the roller sits at its lowest mark

answer.cause: a platen gap set for paper that is too thin
answer.action: Adjust the platen gap for the thickness of the forms

appliesWhen: thick multipart forms jam while single sheets feed fine
explanation: Impact printers print multipart forms, and the platen gap must match the paper thickness. A gap set for thin paper makes thick forms bind and jam.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: nothing prints and twelve jobs wait behind the first one in the queue
the oldest job shows the status Error
the stuck first job was a huge PDF that the user cancelled on the printer panel
the jobs behind the first one have shown the status Waiting all morning

answer.cause: one failed job that blocks the jobs behind it
answer.action: Cancel the job that shows the error

firstStep: Open the print queue and check the status of each job
appliesWhen: the first job in the queue has an error and the rest wait behind it
explanation: Jobs print in order, so a job in an error state blocks every job behind it. Cancel or restart that job and the next one moves to the top.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: this PC has not printed since someone clicked an option in the queue's Printer menu yesterday
the printer icon on this PC is grayed out
other PCs print to the same printer normally, but this PC cannot
the jobs from this PC wait in the queue, but none shows an error

answer.cause: the printer set to work offline on that PC
answer.action: Clear the Use Printer Offline option and resume printing

appliesWhen: jobs wait only on one PC because its queue is set offline or paused
explanation: When the printer is set offline or paused on one PC, its jobs wait in the queue while other PCs print. Clear the option from the queue's Printer menu and the jobs print.
source: CompTIA A+ Core 1 and Core 2 Exam Cram, 2nd ed. – Chapter 28: Troubleshooting Printers

clues: random dots appear all over the printed pages
the dots are in different places on each page
the speckled pages come from a printer that handles labels and envelopes every day
the specks get worse after each batch of envelopes

answer.cause: paper dust and glue residue inside the printer
answer.action: Clean the inside of the printer with compressed air or a toner vacuum

appliesWhen: random dots appear because dirt has built up inside the printer
explanation: Paper dust and residue from envelopes, labels, and staples build up inside the printer and leave random specks. Cleaning it out clears them; use a toner vacuum where loose toner is present.
source: CompTIA A+ Core 1 and Core 2 Exam Cram, 2nd ed. – Chapter 28: Troubleshooting Printers; CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: a faint copy of the previous page shows on each new page
the faint image is offset down the sheet
the faint copies started after a box of pages printed at once
the main image is sharp and dark under the faint copy

answer.cause: a broken cleaning blade or failing erasure lamps
answer.action: Replace the toner cartridge, then the erasure lamps if the images remain

appliesWhen: faint images of earlier pages repeat on new pages
explanation: Ghosting happens when old toner or old charges stay on the drum. A broken cleaning blade is in the toner cartridge, which is the cheaper part, so replace the cartridge first and the erasure lamps if that does not help.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: the printer makes a grinding noise when the carriage starts to move
lines of print are spaced unevenly down the page
the grinding started after someone pushed the carriage by hand while the printer was on
the carriage sometimes stops partway across

answer.cause: a damaged stepper motor
answer.action: Replace the stepper motor, or the printer if the repair costs too much

appliesWhen: a moving part grinds and the print spacing goes wrong because a motor is damaged
explanation: Stepper motors move the printhead and the paper. Forcing them by hand while the power is on damages them, so they lose precision, space the print unevenly, and grind; a motor costs about half the price of a new printer.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: a grinding sound comes from the tray area each time a page is picked
the paper often fails to feed
with the tray out, a flashlight shows the pickup roller skipping as it turns
the grinding stops when the printer is idle

answer.cause: a broken pickup drive gear
answer.action: Replace the pickup drive gear

firstStep: Print a test page with the tray out and watch the pickup roller
appliesWhen: a grinding noise comes with each pick because the gear that drives the roller is missing teeth
explanation: A pickup drive gear or clutch with missing teeth makes the roller skip and grind. If the roller turns evenly, the rollers are worn instead; if it skips, replace the gear.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: stapled jobs stop and the finisher halts with an error
copies without staples finish normally, but stapled jobs halt
the stapled jobs have stopped since the staple cartridge was refilled this morning
a bent staple is visible at the front of the stapler head

answer.cause: a staple jam in the finisher
answer.action: Open the finisher and clear the jammed staples

appliesWhen: a full stapler stops stapling and a bent staple sits in the head
explanation: A finisher staples, punches, and collates the output. When it stops stapling with a full cartridge, a jam in the stapler head is the usual cause; clear it as the manual shows.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: copies come out of the finisher without staples
the copies have no staples although the stapler head is clean and nothing is bent
the staples stopped after the department printed hundreds of stapled reports this week
the stapler unit clicks but nothing comes out

answer.cause: an empty staple cartridge
answer.action: Load a new staple cartridge

appliesWhen: the finisher runs normally but has used up its staples
explanation: A finisher that clicks but does not staple, with no jam inside, has run out of staples. Load a new staple cartridge.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: the finisher stops every job that asks for holes
jobs without holes finish normally while hole-punch jobs stop
the little bin under the punch unit has not been emptied in months, and hole-punch jobs now stop
bits of punched paper spill out when the finisher door is opened to clear a stopped hole-punch job

answer.cause: a full hole-punch waste bin
answer.action: Empty the hole-punch waste bin

appliesWhen: only jobs that need holes stop and paper bits fill the punch area
explanation: The punch unit drops the paper circles into a waste bin. When the bin is full, the finisher stops punching, so empty it and clear any loose bits.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: a wide spreadsheet prints with its right side cut off
the columns are cut at the same place on every page
the same file printed without cut-off columns from another PC
the preview of the cut-off spreadsheet shows a tall page

answer.cause: the page set to portrait instead of landscape
answer.action: Set the orientation to landscape in Printing Preferences

appliesWhen: a wide document is cut off on the right side because it prints on a tall page
explanation: Portrait pages are taller than wide and landscape pages are wider than tall. A wide sheet printed in portrait loses its right side; change the orientation in Printing Preferences.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: legal-size documents from Tray 2 lose the bottom few inches
the cut-off pages began after someone loaded Tray 2 with letter paper last week
letter-size jobs from Tray 1 print fine while legal jobs from Tray 2 are cut off
the printer properties still list Tray 2 as legal although its legal jobs come out cut off

answer.cause: a tray set to a different paper size than it holds
answer.action: Set the correct paper size for the tray in the printer properties

appliesWhen: the tray's size setting does not match the paper loaded in it
explanation: The printer pulls paper from the tray that it thinks holds the right size. If a tray holds letter paper but is set as legal, legal jobs print on letter sheets and lose the bottom.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: users cannot use the new optional tray that was added under the printer
users cannot select the new tray in the print dialog
the new tray is missing from the print dialog although the printer panel shows it with paper
the printer driver lists only Tray 1 and the manual feed, not the new tray

answer.cause: an installable tray that is not enabled in the driver
answer.action: Enable the new tray in the driver's device settings

appliesWhen: the printer sees the tray but the PCs do not offer it
explanation: An added tray must also be set up in the printer's device settings on each PC or print server. Until then the driver does not offer it, even though the printer sees it.

clues: the printer panel reports that Tray 2 is open or missing
the tray warning appeared after the paper guides were moved for a smaller size
the tray sticks out a little past the front of the printer
the warning started after the tray was refilled

answer.cause: a tray that is not pushed fully into place
answer.action: Square the paper guides and push the tray in until it clicks

firstStep: Pull the tray out and check how it seats in its slot
appliesWhen: the printer does not detect a tray that is crooked or not pushed in
explanation: The printer senses a tray only when it sits fully and squarely in its slot. Check that it is seated and aligned and that the guides fit the paper; then check the tray settings and firmware.
source: CompTIA A+ Core 1 and Core 2 Exam Cram, 2nd ed. – Chapter 28: Troubleshooting Printers

clues: nobody can print to the network printer after a power outage
the configuration page shows a different address than last week
the printer that nobody can reach gets its settings from the network automatically
the PCs that cannot print have printer ports that point to the old number

answer.cause: a printer address that DHCP changed
answer.action: Reserve a fixed IP address for the printer and point the printer ports to it

firstStep: Print a configuration page to see the printer's IP address
appliesWhen: the printer's IP address changed and the PCs still send jobs to the old one
explanation: PCs send jobs to the printer's IP address, so a new DHCP lease breaks every mapping. Reserve a static address for the printer and update the ports.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: the printer stopped working after the router was replaced
the printer's panel shows no Wi-Fi bars
the printer that stopped working on Wi-Fi prints fine over a USB cable
the laptops now join a network with a new name and passphrase, but they cannot find the printer

answer.cause: a printer still set up for the old wireless network
answer.action: Connect the printer to the new wireless network from its control panel

appliesWhen: a wireless printer lost its network because the network name or passphrase changed
explanation: A wireless printer joins the network that it was set up for. After a new router with a new name or passphrase, it must be joined to the new network; a USB cable is a way to test it meanwhile.
source: CompTIA A+ Complete Study Guide (Docter) – Core 1 Chapter 13: Mobile Device, Display, and Printer Troubleshooting

clues: jobs stay in the queue and none prints
choosing Cancel on the stuck jobs does nothing
jobs to every printer on this PC are stuck
the printer prints its own test page normally while jobs from the PC stay stuck

answer.cause: a stalled Print Spooler service
answer.action: Stop the Print Spooler, delete the files in the spool folder, and start the service again

appliesWhen: jobs cannot be cancelled and no printer on the PC works
explanation: The print spooler prepares jobs for the printer. When it stalls, jobs freeze and cannot be cancelled; stop the service, clear C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS, and start it again (for example with net stop spooler and net start spooler).
